contracts.inputs: authenticated tenant, item, action, stage, expected current stage, event ID and optional blocker/proof/sharing choice
contracts.outputs: persisted item and one matching activity event
contracts.sideEffects: transactionally updates work_items and inserts work_item_events
contracts.failures: invalid transition, missing proof/blocker, cross-client item, or unauthorized function call fails without partial write
contracts.retry: event ID is stable and unique; a replay returns the existing transition result without duplicating an event
contracts.invariants: stage and attention status remain distinct; only service_role can call the function; historic unknown stages are not guessed

contracts.inputs: authenticated PATCH request scoped to the selected client
contracts.outputs: updated work item or actionable 4xx/5xx error
contracts.sideEffects: calls the transactional database function, then performs existing notification/Slack policy checks
contracts.failures: database failure returns error; post-commit delivery failures are recorded separately and never roll back saved work
contracts.retry: same operation event ID is idempotent at the database boundary
contracts.invariants: normal user authentication and tenant scope are checked before RPC

contracts.inputs: work items, stage metadata, and transition API
contracts.outputs: four stages, visible attention/placement queues, updated cards and drawer
contracts.sideEffects: explicit user moves and activity events
contracts.failures: show server error and retain current card position
contracts.retry: user can retry after refreshing; no optimistic persistence claim
contracts.invariants: Client Review sharing is explicit; keyboard and mobile work; reduced motion is honored
